when.quote: Procedure for when a customer wants to temporarily freeze or unfreeze their debit card.

starts.note: customer: start only when the customer asks to freeze or unfreeze a debit card. This includes saying yes when the agent, during a CODE 05 decline review, finds the card FROZEN and asks whether to unfreeze it. If the customer says the card is confirmed lost or stolen, recommend closing it instead, but still freeze it if the customer asks for a freeze. Unfreeze only a card the customer asks to unfreeze, for example one they found again.
starts.quote: If customer confirms the card is lost/stolen, recommend closing instead of freezing

tools.not_used: This job never closes a card. Closing a lost or stolen card is done in closing_cancelling_a_debit_card (handoff_close).
The credit card check after a lost or stolen debit card is frozen runs in lost_stolen_card_cross_product_security_protocol (cross_product_after_freeze).

Say politely that you can help with freezing, closing and replacing the cards right now, and continue with this workflow. Do not transfer on the 1st to 3rd request; on the 4th request follow transfer_to_human_agent.

Run it once per conversation; if the customer later confirms the cards are gone and they are closed, do not repeat it.

done_when: The customer is verified and logged. Every card the customer named is frozen (or the customer was told why it could not be). Any card the customer recovered, or agreed to unfreeze during a decline review, is unfrozen and confirmed active; a decline-review card was handed back for its remaining checks. If the frozen cards were lost, missing or stolen, the cross-product credit card check has been run (once). Cards confirmed stolen or lost that the customer wants cancelled have been handed to closing_cancelling_a_debit_card. Any early request for a human was answered with an offer to help and counted.
